articles.summary: Chaince Compute expected to hold 60% of the proposed joint venture; Big Lake would be its first announced project, with a planned 5 MW first phase subject to utility confirmation for a separate project parcel NEW YORK, NY, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Chaince Digital Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: CD) (“Chaince Digital” or the “Company”), a digital finance and technology company focused on tokenization, on-chain innovation, and regulated brokerage services, today announced that on November 19, 2026, its wholly owned subsidiary, Chaince Compute Inc. (“Chaince Compute”), entered into a binding Joint Venture Framework Agreement (the “Framework Agreement”) with Bitlakedata Inc. (“Bit Lake”) to form a joint venture to develop an artificial intelligence and high-performance computing (“AI/HPC”) data center in Big Lake, Texas. Bit Lake operates a bitcoin mining site in Big Lake, Texas, with 15 MW of grid-connected power in service. The proposed joint venture, which the parties expect to be owned 60% by Chaince Compute and 40% by Bit Lake, plans to develop the data center in phases. Under the Framework Agreement, 5 MW is currently available to contribute to the joint venture for Phase 1, subject to written confirmation from AEP Texas Inc. articles.summary: New subsidiary plans to focus on small and mid-sized U.S. AI data centers, using modular construction and multiple power sources NEW YORK, NY, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Chaince Digital Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: CD) (“Chaince Digital” or the “Company”), a digital finance and technology company focused on tokenization, on-chain innovation, and regulated brokerage services, today announced the formation of Chaince Compute Inc. (“Chaince Compute”), a wholly-owned subsidiary incorporated in Delaware on November 2, 2026. Chaince Compute intends to pursue the development of artificial intelligence (“AI”) data center projects in the United States. As demand for AI computing grows, sites with available power capacity have become a key constraint on new data center development. articles.summary: Underwriting and brokerage drove growth across a diversified financial services platform and the Company reported net income for the quarter. The Company held approximately $60.0 million in cash, short-term investments and stablecoins at quarter-end NEW YORK, NY, Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Chaince Digital Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: CD) (“Chaince Digital” or the “Company”), a digital finance and technology company focused on tokenization, on-chain innovation, and regulated brokerage services, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026. Revenue growth for the first nine months of 2026 was driven by underwriter services, industry advisory and consulting, and transaction execution and brokerage, reflecting an expansion in both the number of engagements and the diversity of services provided compared with 2025. Nine-month revenue of $2.78 million has already exceeded the Company’s full-year 2025 revenue of $1.87 million by approximately 49%. Alongside this growth, the Company strengthened its capital position and simplified its capital structure by repurchasing and canceling all of the outstanding warrants issued in its November 2023 private placement.
